fusions.name: Spade Throw
fusions.desc: A hurled blow that deals 13 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles, and drives the target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Dust Kick
fusions.desc: Spends 4% of your maximum health to throw up a cone of grit 4 tiles long that deals 8 damage to everything in it and has a 40% chance to leave it [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Earthwork
fusions.desc: Raises a bank of earth 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Burrow Mate
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded mole of earth that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage.
